'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 United Kingdom riots]]
**[[Sheffield Crown Court]] in [[South Yorkshire]], [[UK]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] Thomas Birley, a [[British people|British]] man who [[arson|set fire]] to a hotel that housed [[asylum seekers]] in [[Rotherham]], South Yorkshire, to nine years in prison for arson with the intent to endanger life, the longest sentence related to the riots so far. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/6/uk-man-sentenced-to-nine-years-for-arson-after-far-right-riots (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Prosecution of Donald Trump in New York]]
**[[New York Supreme Court]] justice [[Juan Merchan]] postpones former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s sentencing in his criminal case until after [[Election Day (United States)|Election Day]] on November 5. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/09/06/nyregion/trump-sentencing-delay-ruling.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/legal/judge-rule-donald-trumps-bid-delay-hush-money-sentencing-2024-09-06/ (Reuters)]
